resolution: Retain the frozen proportional six-family control reduction and the sixteen same-color treatment replacements. Retain exact equality of supervised-token totals, optimizer steps, role slots, replay slots, intervention count, and every non-intervention schedule record. Replace exact equality of total transformer tokens with a prospective bounded-difference rule that permits only the minimum unavoidable transformer-token delta induced by the mandatory rotate control row.
scientific_reason: Changing the proportional allocation or dropping rotate would alter the intended replay-allocation contrast and protection coverage. The transformer-token mismatch is instead a deterministic consequence of the family content: every same-color intervention row has sequence_length minus two times supervised_tokens equal to zero, while every available rotate control row has a strictly positive value. Supervised-token equality preserves the directly optimized target-token dose; equal optimizer steps and fixed slot structure preserve update count and ordering. A minimized sub-0.1-percent transformer-token difference is therefore the smallest explicit and scientifically bounded relaxation that preserves the original causal question.

revised_rc3a_constraint.transformer_token_rule: Use a deterministic global solver to minimize the absolute arm-level transformer-token difference subject to all exact constraints. The frozen difference must be the minimum feasible value and must not exceed 0.001 of the smaller arm's total transformer-token count. Record the exact signed and absolute difference before any model loading.
revised_rc3a_constraint.content_integrity: Do not pad, truncate, duplicate tokens within a sample, modify prompts or labels, or alter tokenizer output to manufacture equality.
revised_rc3a_constraint.fail_closed: If exact supervised-token equality and all proportional family counts cannot be achieved, or if the minimum feasible transformer-token difference exceeds the 0.001 bound, pause Stage A and return for a new scientific review. No further matching relaxation is automatic.

unchanged_conditions: The quantitative causal decision rule remains unchanged.
Weak-atomic and protected-capability gates remain unchanged.
The common prospective evaluation and Batch1 cross-check contract remain unchanged.
The treatment assigns exactly sixteen of eighty replay slots to train-only same-color examples.
Both arms start from the identical frozen V7 checkpoint.
Budget and arm isolation remain unchanged.
V7, R1, R2, the stopped V1 protocol, and prior diagnostics remain immutable.
required_next_artifact: One immutable CPU-only RC3A schedule package containing the deterministic solver identity, exact proportional family counts, exact supervised-token equality, exact optimizer and slot equality, minimized transformer-token delta and ratio, complete schedule hashes, and unchanged RC1, RC2, RC4, and RC5 hashes.
